review_candidates.title: Sr. Systems Engineer (Linux)
review_candidates.description: Job Description About Williams-Sonoma, Inc. Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization. With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide. Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide. Role Overview As Senior Linux Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, automation, standardization, and lifecycle management of Williams-Sonoma's Linux estate. You will help improve platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency across on-premises and cloud-hosted environments. This role is ideal for a hands-on infrastructure engineer with strong Linux fundamentals, growing automation capabilities, and sound operational judgment. You will partner closely with senior engineers, architects, and support teams to deliver reliable platform services, improve day-to-day operations, and contribute to the continued evolution of Linux platform engineering. Impact of the Role Improve platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency across enterprise Linux environments. Drive automation and infrastructure-as-code practices across provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, and operational workflows. Support the modernization and evolution of Linux platform engineering. Enhance operational readiness, incident response effectiveness, and platform observability. Support enterprise infrastructure powering large-scale digital commerce and business operations. Technology Platforms You Will Work On Red Hat Enterprise Linux Red Hat Satellite Ansible GitHub Kubernetes Docker Jenkins Bash and Python scripting Virtualization and cloud infrastructure platforms Apache and Tomcat Linux-hosted database platforms Active Directory integration for Linux Monitoring and observability platforms Key Responsibilities Define, implement, and maintain enterprise standards for Linux platforms, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux and related tooling. Engineer and support platform capabilities across OS lifecycle management, patching, repository services, configuration management, automation, and platform hardening. Design and optimize Linux platform performance through kernel, system, and application tuning based on capacity, reliability, and availability requirements. Drive automation and infrastructure-as-code practices across provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, and operational workflows. Leverage AI-assisted engineering practices for personal productivity and continuous improvement, including proactive monitoring workflows, script development, and log analysis to accelerate troubleshooting, reduce manual effort, and improve operational insight. Administer and improve core Linux support services and toolchains such as Satellite, Ansible, GitHub, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, and related platform components. Partner with architects and peer engineering teams to evaluate new technologies, run proof-of-concept initiatives, and contribute to the Linux platform roadmap. Gather technical and business requirements and translate them into scalable infrastructure designs and implementation plans. Collaborate closely with production support and Level 2 operations teams to improve runbooks, handoffs, operational readiness, and incident response effectiveness. Create and maintain high-quality engineering documentation, including standards, build guides, implementation records, and operational procedures. Provide data-driven recommendations on platform health, capacity, risk, and modernization opportunities. Share knowledge with other engineers through documentation, collaboration, design reviews, and hands-on problem solving. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Sciences, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent combination of related education, training, and experience. 10+ years of managing Linux operating systems in an enterprise environment. 7+ years leading technical teams that solve complex problems and provide detailed technical and business analysis. Deep expertise in Linux systems engineering within complex enterprise environments, including performance, security, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting. Strong experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux and adjacent platform tooling for package management, patching, configuration, and automation. Hands-on experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, and other shell-based tooling. Demonstrated interest in responsibly using AI tools to strengthen personal engineering effectiveness, especially for drafting scripts, identifying patterns in logs and telemetry, and supporting faster root-cause analysis. Working knowledge of virtualization and cloud infrastructure platforms, along with modern container technologies and orchestration concepts. Experience with configuration management and automation platforms such as Ansible or equivalent tools. Strong understanding of Linux security best practices, system hardening, access controls, and operational compliance requirements. Experience supporting web and middleware stacks on Linux, such as Apache and Tomcat, and familiarity with database platforms in Linux-hosted environments. Experience with enterprise patching and content management solutions such as Red Hat Satellite is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Active Directory integration for Linux, including service principals, Kerberos, and keytab-based authentication, is a plus. Strong documentation, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineering and business stakeholders. A practical, ownership-oriented mindset and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Fundamental understanding of deploying and supporting Linux servers in a highly available and fault tolerant enterprise level environment. Delivery of fully integrated, automated, and highly available Linux provisioning process with enterprise level tools and technologies. Superior oral and written communication skills. Superior computer skills including MS Windows and MS Office including Excel, Access, Visio, and Word. ServiceNow experience is a plus. Knowledge of theory and principles of project management. Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family. Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact. Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale. Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges. Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement. About Us Williams-Sonoma India Pvt. Ltd. Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide. Williams-Sonoma India sourcing office was established in 2013. You get execute access early, and we'd like you to use it and attach the output to the ticket. • Scope and coordinate remote hands work with data center technicians. That means writing a task somebody on the floor can carry out without calling you, and verifying it was done before you close anything. • Write internal notes that let the next shift continue without re-investigating. This is one of the standards we hold most consistently. • Escalate with evidence: what you checked, what you found, what you already tried, and what you need. At the L2 end of the band, add owning the harder tickets on your shift, being the person L1s bring a stuck problem to, holding remote hands coordination for the whole shift rather than just your own tickets, and taking first pass on tickets nobody else has been able to close. What we're looking for You read the whole thread before you reply. You verify a server is reachable before telling a client it's reachable, and you know a ping reply isn't that verification. When you spot something wrong next to the thing you were asked to fix, you flag it rather than leaving it for whoever finds it next. You can tell the difference between "I don't know" and "this isn't mine." The first comes with a description of what you've already ruled out. The second goes to the right team with enough context that they don't repeat your work. You handle a frustrated client like a professional, and you write the reply the situation calls for rather than reaching for the nearest template. And you're curious. That matters more to us than any certification. The people who do well here want to know why the thing broke, not just how to make the ticket go away. The rest we can teach. Technical baseline This is what we'll test. Where you picked it up doesn't matter to us. • Linux command line. Comfortable diagnosing and working without looking up every command. This is the floor. • Hardware. Disk types and interfaces, SMART attributes and what they mean, RAID levels and controller behavior, NIC types and form factors, server components and how they fail. • Networking fundamentals. IP addressing and subnetting, VLANs, the difference between ping, SSH, and application reachability, basic routing, reading latency and packet loss. • Written English clear enough for direct client communication. You'll be writing to clients daily. We're reading for clarity, not for accent or polish. Nice to have • Proxmox VE or VMware • WHMCS or a comparable ticketing platform • Packet capture with tcpdump or Wireshark • Docker or Kubernetes basics • Any scripting, in anything Certifications aren't required. We test the baseline directly, so not having one won't count against you. Things worth knowing before you apply Templates will only take you so far here, because most tickets need a real diagnosis behind the reply. The role expects you to look at problems next to the one you were handed rather than staying strictly in your lane. And passing a ticket to another team counts as a handoff, with the evidence attached, rather than as a resolution. We'd rather you know all of that up front, so you can judge whether it sounds like the kind of work you want. How to apply Send a CV if you have one. If your CV doesn't show what you can actually do, send us something that does instead: • A short writeup of your homelab or home network. What's in it, why you built it that way, what broke and how you found out. • Something you automated, however small. A script, a playbook, a repo. • A war story. The worst outage or hardware failure you've dealt with, what you thought it was at first, and what it turned out to be. Two or three paragraphs is plenty. We read these, and for people without a conventional background they carry more weight than the CV does. How we hire A written screening exercise first, then a live technical interview. The written stage is deliberate: explaining a problem in writing is most of this job, and we'd rather see that before we take your time on a call. We tell you yes or no either way, with the reason.

Amentum is seeking a full-time Senior Database Administrator to support a Department of War (DoW) customer in Spokane, Washington. The successful candidate will provide enterprise database administration and SharePoint infrastructure support in a secure DoW environment. This position requires extensive experience administering Microsoft SQL Server, SharePoint 2019 on-premises, Windows Server technologies, cybersecurity compliance, and enterprise infrastructure. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical expertise, excellent troubleshooting skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a highly structured mission-focused environment. Design, implement, and support secure, highly available database solutions. Monitor database health, performance, and capacity; perform query tuning, index optimization, and routine maintenance. Manage database backup, recovery, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle activities. Configure and maintain high availability technologies including Always On Availability Groups and failover clustering. Implement database security through access controls, encryption, auditing, and STIG compliance. Troubleshoot database performance, connectivity, replication, and integrity issues. Develop automation scripts using PowerShell and T-SQL to improve operational efficiency. Collaborate with developers on database design, schema changes, stored procedures, and application performance optimization. Create custom reports based on customer requirements. Manage SharePoint farms, site collections, service applications, content databases, permissions, and Active Directory integration. Support SharePoint customizations using ASP.NET Web Forms, ASP.NET MVC, C#, CSOM, and SharePoint Server APIs. Configure and maintain document libraries, lists, workflows, and enterprise collaboration features. Perform SharePoint backup, restoration, disaster recovery testing, and system maintenance. Provide technical support to site owners and end users while resolving SharePoint-related issues. Security, Operations & Collaboration Apply DoD STIGs, RMF security controls, vulnerability remediation, and cybersecurity best practices.
